metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.1 · 2017 · County Line
metas.description: When former sheriff Alden Rockwell's best friend is shot, he volunteers as a private investigator to find out the truth behind the shooting and discovers a criminal conspiracy between two counties.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.7 · 2022 · County Line: All In
metas.description: Sheriff Rockwell teams up with the new sheriff of York County, a young woman, to solve a murder that happened on the county line.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.5 · 2022 · County Line: No Fear
metas.description: Alden Rockwell's retirement plans are interrupted when a crime syndicate threatens the family of neighboring York County sheriff Joanne "Jo" Porter, starting a chain reaction that turns into a battle for the future of the two counties.
